page: Microsoft Azure D48ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Dadv6 server family. Powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor with x86_64 architecture, it features 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The CPU operates at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz, supported by 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. It includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 (including VNNI and BF16) and cryptography acceleration via AES and SHA_NI. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB per core ratio, and includes 2835 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capability.

Performance benchmarks indicate top-tier capabilities in single-core CPU execution and multi-core Geekbench processing. The server demonstrates strong multi-core performance in stress-ng and bzip3 decompression, alongside high memory bandwidth for small cached blocks. Cryptographic operations, database transactions, and Redis SET operations also rank in the top 25% of tested systems. However, large-block uncached memory read/write speeds and static web serving throughput fall within the average range. For machine learning workloads, the CPU delivers top-tier text generation speeds for small 135M parameter models, but performance drops to average for medium 7B models and is poor for large 70B models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the D48ads_v6 offers a dense allocation of compute, memory, and high-capacity local storage without the overhead of dedicated GPU hardware. This makes it a balanced option for resource-heavy workloads that require fast local disk access. The instance is highly suited for relational databases, Redis caching layers, software compilation, multi-threaded data processing, and lightweight LLM inference tasks.
description: Microsoft Azure D48ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine from the Dadv6 family, powered by a 3.7 GHz AMD EPYC 9V74 processor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs (24 physical cores), 192.0 GB of RAM, and 2835 GB of local storage. Operating on Microsoft Hyper-V, this x86_64 server supports AVX-512 and cryptographic acceleration. Benchmarks show top-tier single-core CPU and multi-core Geekbench performance, with strong results in database operations, Redis transactions, and software compilation. However, uncached memory bandwidth and large-model LLM inference speeds are average to poor. Lacking a GPU, it relies on its high-capacity local storage and balanced compute-to-memory ratio to deliver qualitative cost efficiency for data-intensive applications. It is best suited for database hosting, caching layers, software development pipelines, and multi-threaded data processing.
